format_note: Parquet, not CSV. pandas to_csv does not round-trip float64 exactly in this environment - a plain round-trip moved 476 of 8344 values by up to 7.3e-12, and float_format='%.17g' moved 1458 - which would have made an exact benchmarks-unchanged comparison impossible to state.
production_use: PROHIBITED. No runtime loader, pack builder or dashboard consumer may read this directory. These values are superseded and less accurate than the published pack.
purpose: Quarterly display values as published by the BADLY CONDITIONED Denton solve, frozen so the reconditioning before/after audit can be regenerated without reading a historical Git object - a shallow CI checkout may not contain that commit. The unnormalised KKT system reached a condition number of ~5.8e9 on the raw net-km indicators and lost about 1e-6 of relative precision, so these values are accurate to only about six significant figures for every series benchmarked on a net-km indicator. The official annual rows are included because the audit must prove they did NOT move; they never pass through the solve.
